items.rationale: Policy 7.1.7(f): One travel/call-out charge per contractor per invoice is indemnified. Reference cases 51, 50, 46, 44, 43, 40, 39 show vehicle costs for similar claims are routinely indemnified at €65–98 per job.
Policy 7.1.7(c): Consumable installation material needed for the repair is covered. Reference 39: sealing material for pipe repair was indemnified at €24.
Policy 7.1.7(c): Replacement pipe of equivalent spec is covered. Reference 39: stainless steel pipe 1 m was indemnified at €31–42.
Policy 7.1.7(c): Standard insulation to match pre-loss is covered. Reference 39: rock wool pipe insulation 1 m was indemnified at €22.
Policy 7.1.7(g): Labour for necessary repair is covered. Reference 39: installer hours for pipe repair were indemnified at €76/hr.
Policy 7.1.7(g): Labour for necessary repair is covered. Reference 39: service technician hours for similar work were indemnified at €732 for 9 hrs.
Policy 7.1.7(b), (e): Necessary drying is covered, one flat-rate charge per drying operation. Reference 39: construction dryer flat-rate charge was indemnified at €403; 51 at €580+.

items.description: Painting the disturbed wall area and closing the wall opening
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.7(a), (c): Making good the opening and repainting the disturbed area is covered. Reference 39: €416+; 51: €633+ for similar work.

items.description: Full repaint of the entire wall on which the opening was located
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.6: Only the affected patch is covered unless a visible discontinuity would remain and matching material is unavailable. Here, the same paint was available, so full-wall repaint is not indemnified.

items.description: Repaint of the remaining bathroom walls and ceiling to match
items.rationale: Policy 7.1.5, 7.1.6: Work beyond the affected wall is not covered, even for matching. The same paint was available, so no visible discontinuity. Not indemnified.
